column1: # Every ID field of every RPC reply in the public contract, recursively: a
# non-repeated scalar field named `id` or ending in `_id`, as the generated
# messages of this SDK declare it. A guard test walks the generated reply
# messages and fails when a field is missing here or listed but gone, so a new
# ID in the contract must be classified before the build passes.
# required: the identity of the object a reply returns, or the ID a write
# reply assigns or echoes. A decoder of the reply refuses 0 (or "") with the
# response-contract error. Inside a nested message the reply may leave out,
# it is checked when the message is present.
# not_required: a reference to another object, a catalog key, a cursor, a
# client correlation ID, or a field the contract allows to be 0 or empty.
